o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish كون (gün), from Proto-Turkic *kün (“sun, day”).
Internationalism; via Russian та́ктика (táktika), ultimately from Ancient Greek τακτικός (taktikós, “fit for ordering”).
Ultimately from Arabic طَلَبَات (ṭalabāt), plural of طَلَب (ṭalab).
Borrowed from Classical Persian دانشگاه (dānišgāh). By surface analysis, daniş + -gah.
